metadata.name: outcry
metadata.description: Outcry: private open-outcry card trading table on a MagicBlock TEE ephemeral rollup

instructions.name: bot_tick
docs: ER: one bot step (permissionless, rate limited; normally driven by the crank). Rings
the bell when the window is over. Bots read only their own seat and the public book.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: ER: remove own quote.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Base: create a table and its four private seats. Seats are pre-funded so they can pay
their own ephemeral-permission rent on the ER.

instructions.name: deal
docs: ER, VRF callback: deal the round. Bound to the round it was requested for; a late or
duplicate callback is a no-op.

instructions.name: delegate_seat
docs: Base: delegate one seat to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: delegate_table
docs: Base: delegate the table to the TEE validator (once; the table is then reused).

instructions.name: init_permissions
docs: ER: create the four seat permissions (private, no members yet). Idempotent.

instructions.name: init_record
docs: Base: create the lifetime record of a wallet (anyone may pay for it).

instructions.name: join
docs: ER: take a bot seat. `wallet` (optional co-signer) binds the seat to a base-layer
`PlayerRecord`; without it the seat plays anonymously.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: Optional wallet co-signature binding the seat to that wallet's record.

instructions.name: leave
docs: ER: give a seat back to the house bot (any time; a bot finishes the hand).

instructions.name: publish_records
docs: ER: send this round's results to the base-layer player records through a standalone
Magic Action (no commit, so no commit nonce is consumed). Anyone may call it once per
round after the bell; the caller is the intent payer.

instructions.name: quote
docs: ER: post or replace own quote. `side` 0 = bid, 1 = ask.

instructions.name: record_round
docs: Base, Magic Action only: apply one round's results to the players' records. The escrow
signer proves the delegation program dispatched it, and binding `escrow_auth` to the
table PDA proves this program scheduled it for that table. Idempotent per (table, round).

instructions.name: ring_bell
docs: ER: ring the bell once the window has ended (anyone). Scores, ranks, then flips every
seat permission public for the reveal.

instructions.name: set_window
docs: ER: change the trading window (creator only, between rounds).

instructions.name: start_round
docs: ER: start a round. Seals every seat (private permission, owner as the only member),
requests VRF from the ephemeral queue, and optionally schedules the bot/bell crank.

instructions.name: take
docs: ER: trade one card against `counterparty`'s resting quote on `side` of `suit`, at its
price. Taking an ask buys; taking a bid sells.

instructions.name: undelegate_table
docs: ER: retire the table (creator only, between rounds). Closes the four seat permissions
(rent back to the seats), then commits and undelegates the table and seats to base.

errors.name: NotSeatOwner
errors.msg: Signer does not own this seat

errors.name: NoCard
errors.msg: Seller does not hold a card of that suit

errors.name: NoChips
errors.msg: Buyer does not hold enough chips

errors.name: SelfCross
errors.msg: Quote would cross your own quote

errors.name: SelfTrade
errors.msg: Cannot trade against your own quote

errors.name: SeatTaken
errors.msg: Seat already taken by a player

errors.name: AlreadySeated
errors.msg: Signer already sits at this table

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.msg: Only a seated player or the table creator may do this

errors.name: AlreadyPublished
errors.msg: Records for this round were already published

errors.name: SeatMismatch
errors.msg: Seat account does not match the table/index

types.name: PlayerRecord
docs: Lifetime stats of one wallet. Lives on the base layer, never delegated; written by a
Magic Action scheduled from the ER after each bell.

fields.name: last_table
docs: Idempotency key of the last applied result.

types.name: RecordEntry
docs: One seat's result as carried by the record action.

types.name: Seat
docs: Private per-seat state: hand, chips and secret order. Readable only by the seat owner
(ephemeral permission) until the bell flips it public.

fields.name: round
docs: Round these cards belong to.

types.name: SeatInfo
docs: Public roster entry for one seat.

fields.name: owner
docs: Signer allowed to act for this seat (session key). Default for bots.

fields.name: wallet
docs: Wallet whose base-layer `PlayerRecord` receives this seat's results. Default if none.

types.name: Table
docs: Public table state. Delegated to the TEE validator once and reused round after round.
Zero-copy so the 64-entry tape never lands on the BPF stack.

fields.name: trade_end_ts
docs: Trading closes at this ER unix timestamp.

fields.name: deal_requested_ts
docs: When the current deal's VRF request was sent (for retry after a lost callback).

fields.name: last_tick_slot
docs: Last slot a `bot_tick` ran (rate limit for the permissionless tick).

fields.name: crank_task_id
docs: Task id of the crank scheduled for the current round.

fields.name: trade_count
docs: Total fills ever written to the tape (the ring index is `trade_count % TAPE_LEN`).

fields.name: records_round
docs: Last round whose results were sent to the base-layer player records.

fields.name: bids
docs: `bids[suit][seat]` resting bid price, 0 = none.

fields.name: asks
docs: `asks[suit][seat]` resting ask price, 0 = none.

fields.name: scores
docs: Filled in by the bell.

types.name: Trade
docs: One fill on the public tape.
